title: HMD settings
description: Settings accepted in config.yaml. Each top-level section is one settings page and each nested object a group on it. A key's environment variable is HMD_ followed by its upper-case dotted path with underscores (server.bind is HMD_SERVER_BIND); lists have none. A setting marked x-env-only is read from the environment only, never from config.yaml; x-env names its variable when it differs, and x-secret hides its value.

bind.title: bind
bind.description: Address and port HMD listens on, in host:port form. Use 127.0.0.1:8080 to accept connections from this computer only.

repo_dir.title: repo dir
repo_dir.description: Private directory holding the Git repository of pages, attachments and wiki configuration. Must not overlap the app directory.

app_dir.title: app dir
app_dir.description: Private application state directory; defaults to /data/app.

config_file.title: config file
config_file.description: Path to the YAML configuration file; overrides the default location in the app directory.

base_url.title: base URL
base_url.description: Public origin of HMD, such as https://wiki.example.com, with no path. Browser writes must come from this origin; MCP upload links and the OIDC callback use it. Required for MCP and OIDC.

trusted_proxies.title: trusted proxies
trusted_proxies.description: CIDR ranges of reverse proxies allowed to set X-Forwarded-Proto. List only proxies you control.

read_only.title: read-only mode
read_only.description: Serve the wiki without allowing edits, uploads, setup, administrator operations, settings changes or pushes. Set only in the environment, so the settings screen cannot switch it on and leave no way back.

debug.title: debug logging
debug.description: Log at debug level. Logs never include credentials, queries or page bodies.

max_upload_bytes.title: max upload (bytes)
max_upload_bytes.description: Largest attachment upload accepted, in bytes (default 10 MiB).

tika_timeout.title: tika timeout (seconds)
tika_timeout.description: How long startup waits for Tika to be available before failing. 0 checks once.

skin.title: default skin
skin.description: Skin used for users who have not chosen their own.

user.title: user
user.description: Bootstrap administrator user name, managed from the environment rather than config.yaml.

password.title: password
password.description: Bootstrap administrator password, managed from the environment rather than config.yaml.

remote_url.title: remote url
remote_url.description: HTTPS URL of an optional Git remote to push to. Leave empty to keep the repository local only.

user.title: git user
user.description: User name sent to the Git remote when authenticating.

author.title: git author (default)
author.description: Commit author, as Name <email>, for users who have not set a personal Git author.

token_file.title: git token file
token_file.description: Path to a private file (mode 0600 or stricter) containing the Git remote token.

token.title: git token
token.description: Personal access token for the Git remote.

branch.title: branch
branch.description: Git branch that HMD commits to and pushes.

sync_mode.title: sync mode
sync_mode.description: push sends local commits to the remote only. bidirectional also fetches and fast-forwards remote changes; divergent histories fail rather than merge.

sync_poll_ms.title: sync poll (ms)
sync_poll_ms.description: Interval in milliseconds between browser sync-status checks; in read-only mode also the background fetch interval, which is fixed at startup.

enabled.title: enable MCP
enabled.description: Serve the MCP endpoint at /_/mcp so AI assistants can use the wiki with a personal access token. Requires server.base_url.

enabled.title: enable OAuth for MCP clients
enabled.description: Let MCP clients sign in with OAuth instead of a pasted token. Requires MCP and an https server.base_url; http is allowed only on loopback with insecure loopback enabled.

dynamic_registration.title: allow dynamic client registration
dynamic_registration.description: Let MCP clients register themselves. When off, an administrator registers each client under MCP OAuth clients.

allow_insecure_loopback.title: allow insecure loopback
allow_insecure_loopback.description: Development only: permit http OAuth origins on loopback addresses.

allow_admin_delegation.title: allow administrator delegation
allow_admin_delegation.description: Allow an administrator to grant a client the settings scope during OAuth consent.

issuer.title: issuer
issuer.description: HTTPS issuer URL of the OpenID Connect provider. Setting it enables single sign-on; register <base_url>/_/auth/oidc/callback with the provider.

client_id.title: client ID
client_id.description: Client ID issued by the identity provider.

client_secret_file.title: client secret file
client_secret_file.description: Path to a private file (mode 0600 or stricter) containing the OIDC client secret.

client_secret.title: client secret
client_secret.description: Client secret issued by the identity provider.

local_login.title: allow local login
local_login.description: Keep the username and password form alongside single sign-on. Useful as a fallback if the provider is unavailable.

button_text.title: button text
button_text.description: Label of the single sign-on login button.

icon.title: icon
icon.description: Dashboard Icons name, or path to a square SVG, shown on the login button.

default_scopes.title: default scopes
default_scopes.description: Scopes given to a user the first time they sign in with OIDC: any of read, write and settings.

allowed_subjects.title: allowed subjects
allowed_subjects.description: Provider subject IDs allowed to sign in. Required unless email domains or any authenticated identity are allowed.

allowed_email_domains.title: allowed email domains
allowed_email_domains.description: Email domains, such as example.com, whose verified addresses may sign in.

allow_any_authenticated.title: allow any authenticated identity
allow_any_authenticated.description: Admit anyone the identity provider authenticates, instead of using an HMD allowlist.

allow_insecure_loopback.title: allow insecure loopback
allow_insecure_loopback.description: Development only: permit an http issuer on loopback addresses.

tika_url.title: document extraction
tika_url.description: URL of a private Apache Tika server, such as http://tika:9998, used to extract text from PDF and Office attachments for search. Leave empty to turn document extraction off; HMD checks the server at startup.

model.title: search model
model.description: Hugging Face model, as owner/model, used for semantic attachment search. Must produce 384-dimensional ONNX output.

model_dir.title: model directory
model_dir.description: Directory holding the embedding model; defaults to models under the app directory.

index_dir.title: search index directory
index_dir.description: Directory holding the document search index.
